limits: These predicates do not apply article transformations, publish, or execute DOM event handlers.
Native complete UI action races and fresh controls must pass separately.

Direct refresh/spelling jobs assess caller-supplied replacements. They are not proof of a selected offer, trusted DOM event or real UI authorization. Fresh/stale offer and source-bound application require the separate native browser workflows.
Minor marking is a user preference and never substitutes for preservation or composition checks. Editor ownership and manual checkbox overrides are tested separately in native browsers.
Count equivalence uses the existing exact retained-count helper, including unknown counts.
This runner executes no native DOM Undo, deadline or responsiveness scenario. Native browser tests are required separately.
